question: 新项目批准创建时，初始项目权限采用哪种方式？
confirmedSourceGap: Approved project has no formal access rule and the first rule configuration UI requires project readability.
recommendedContract: Within approved project creation transaction, create one formal USER/OWNER rule for the selected enabled same-tenant project leader. Grant no implicit creator, applicant, reviewer or admin access.
alternativeContract: Add explicit project access configuration to the creation application and persist the approved selected rules.
actualUserAnswer: 采用负责人 OWNER 方案（建议）
dependentWork: Implement the confirmed selected-leader USER/OWNER contract, complete independent Review and runtime verification. The code candidate passed 154 targeted tests; no actual project data was created.
